headlines.title: Trump rebukes Jeanine Pirro over decision to drop Reflecting Pool vandalism case
headlines.description: President Donald Trump criticized longtime ally Jeanine Pirro Saturday after she agreed to drop a case against a former Olympic canoeist who was accused of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.

headlines.title: Truth Social launches service selling faster access to Trump posts
headlines.description: Wall Street firms can now be alerted of the “most market-moving” social media posts from President Donald Trump before the general public — as long as they pay the right price.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson launches first general election ad in Maine Senate race
headlines.description: Maine’s Democratic Senate nominee Troy Jackson is launching his first general election ad, highlighting his own background as a labor organizer and going after Republican Sen.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll revive ‘anti-weaponization’ fund if Blanche’s nomination for AG is blocked
headlines.description: Trump threatened to “push hard” to keep a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization” fund active, amid an ongoing feud between two Republican senators and the Trump administration over Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general.

headlines.title: Governors find common ground around America 200: Meet the Press Archive
headlines.description: July 4, 1976 — On a special edition of Meet the Press broadcast live from Philadelphia, governors from across the country and both parties joined the program to mark the nation’s bicentennial: Govs. Michael Dukakis (D-Mass.), Robert Ray (R-Iowa), Wendell Anderson (D-Minn.), Mills Godwin (R-Va.) and Milton Shapp (D-Pa.).

headlines.title: FBI warns of cyberattacks on water systems in 7 states
headlines.description: The FBI issued a warning about cyberattacks on municipal water systems in seven states. In Minnesota alone, more than 30 water systems have been attacked and a senior law enforcement official told NBC News that the attack bears all the hallmarks of Iranian- backed hackers. Today President Trump dismissed the idea that Iran is responsible.

headlines.title: Trump says Iran not behind Minnesota water facility hacks despite ‘hallmarks’ of Iranian meddling
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating possible ties between Iran and cyberattacks on water systems in Minnesota and at least six other states. During a cabinet meeting, President Trump denied Iran was responsible and instead blamed Minnesota’s Democratic Governor Tim Walz. NBC News correspondents Garrett Haake, Tom Winter and Dan De Luce bring their latest reporting on the attacks and the warning signs leading up to the hacks.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump defends ‘anti-weaponization’ fund, further complicating Blanche nomination
headlines.description: Republicans Thom Tillis and John Cornyn have been holding up Todd Blanche’s nomination for attorney general, seeking assurances the controversial fund is dead.

headlines.title: Trump appeals ruling that found his $10B IRS suit aimed to ‘manipulate’ legal proceedings
headlines.description: The case is at the center of negotiations between two Republican senators and the Justice Department over Todd Blanche’s nomination to serve as attorney general.

headlines.title: Vermont’s GOP governor defends state-run elections and mail-in voting
headlines.description: Vermont’s GOP governor, Phil Scott, defended mail-in voting and state-run elections as a good option for Americans, rejecting Trump’s calls for the Republicans to “nationalize” elections and limit options for mail-in voting.

headlines.title: Abortion is on the ballot again in these two states: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
